purpose: Supplement to run_metadata.json. The original file is kept byte-identical because scoring hashed it; this file only adds facts that the original does not record.

location_history.note: Folder name and run_id differ on purpose; run_id is left as recorded.

execution.recorded_execution_command_status: accurate: the inner generate.py call made by run_generate.sh; the duplicated --out path is the real output path at run time

config_after_promotion.difference: code/config.yaml adds the top-level 'scoring' section (experiment-team evaluator settings). All sections recorded in run_metadata.json are identical, so the file hash differs while generation settings do not.
